newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - PepsiCo rises.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - PepsiCo rises.

text.p: Shares of PepsiCo Inc rose in U.S. pre-opening trade Monday, boosted by news that it would reorganize North American bottling operations.
Traders said PepsiCo was at 37-3/8 after closing Friday at 36-3/4.
"It's up on this restructuring news," one said.
The Wall Street Journal reported PepsiCo would create a separate unit out of its North American botting operations.
The newspaper said the reorganization might signal a prelude to an eventual spinoff and public offering of the bottling business, a move denied by company officials.

Chip maker Intel Corp was at 151-1/8 after closing Friday at 151-1/2. Intel recovered Friday after falling more than 15 percent at the opening when it warned its second-quarter results would be lower than expected.
Among other technology stocks, Texas Instruments Inc fell 1/2, to 89-3/8. A market source said Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette downgraded the shares to market perform from buy.
Traders reported little activity. "It's a pretty slow day," one said.
